title: Club Members in Scarlet
overview: Tori is still naked and the battle continues with the battle against the Tres Espana and Europe!

title: The Soothsayers Take the Stage
overview: With the cargo ship crashed into England soil, the fighting has been put on hold until a treaty can be reached.

title: Those Setting Foot Upon the Ground
overview: Musashi ‘s Shirojiro Bertoni is negotiating with England’s Charles Howard over the upcoming joint school event; A vicious back and forth between two skilled treasurers as the residents watch.

title: Ruler of the Theatre
overview: Musashi prepares for the upcoming school event as Tres España makes their appearance.

title: The Hunting Ground's Humanitarians
overview: The “exhibition” fights have started against Musashi and England, while Horizon and Tori discuss terms of their date.

title: The Man and Woman in the Plaza
overview: The fights are coming to an end and their a few members of Musashi are missing. To make thing worse, Bloody Double Mary has decided to make her appearance.

title: Storyteller in the Hall
overview: The fighting has ended, but the battle of politics is beginning. Musashi has a few tricks up their sleeves but an unannounced party may ruin everything.

title: The Decision Maker on High
overview: With all the acronymed groups butting in, Musashi is forced to think quick before the newcomer brings their house of cards crashing in. If accepted, the new plan will offer them a chance to see behind the curtain and into the apocalypse.

title: One Parting Under the Night Sky
overview: Even though Musashi agreed to be a mercenary for England in the upcoming war, plans are derailed by a letter of resignation from Tenzo Clothunit.

title: Howler at the Theatre
overview: Two writers clash over Shakespeare work as the students work together for Tenzo to make it to his date.

title: Successful Candidate in the Flower Garden
overview: As Tenzo battles the Fairy Queen for his Mary’s life, the Inadequate HQ must overcome Spain’s barrage attack or they will lose the war.

title: Where the One Scarred by Swords Belongs
overview: The battle is heating up with the Gods of War and the baseball team pressing Musashi. With the help of non-combative students, Musashi plans to turn the war around.

title: The Greedy Ones who Cross Borders
overview: Spain and Musashi are going for broke with Spain gaining the upper hand. But when England relinquishes its Armor of Deadly Sins, Musashi finally gains the upper hand.
